statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on absence of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other significant arrhythmias
